use: unit 4 records: record cards and «find it» tasks
approvalRule: approval.contentSha256 = first 16 hex of sha256 over {id, name, fact, caveat, disputed} (JSON, sorted keys, UTF-8). If any of these change, the approval no longer matches and the card must be re-approved before it is shown.

fact.en: The Volga has the largest delta in Europe.
fact.ru: У Волги самая большая дельта в Европе.

fact.en: The Loire is the longest river in France, about 1,000 km long.
fact.ru: Луара — самая длинная река Франции, около 1000 км.

fact.en: The Tagus is the longest river of the Iberian Peninsula, about 1,000 km long.
fact.ru: Тахо — самая длинная река Пиренейского полуострова, около 1000 км.
